instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: GlobalMart is a medium-sized e-commerce platform specializing in consumer goods across three major categories. It operates primarily through its own website and several third-party marketplaces, serving a loyal customer base focused on convenience.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has recently implemented A/B testing frameworks for UI improvements and conducted quarterly product roadmap reviews to align with seasonal market trends. They have also piloted an in-house logistics optimization project.
answers.strategicGoals: To maintain a dominant market share within the consumer electronics segment and reduce customer churn by offering superior service experiences. The primary goal is preserving existing revenue streams against aggressive competitors.
answers.teamSize: The core innovation team consists of 5 product managers and 2 software engineers, reporting directly to the C-suite. They are lean but highly specialized.
answers.additionalContext: The company faces intense price competition and rapid technological shifts in logistics, requiring continuous adaptation to stay relevant.

opportunities.title: Personalized Loyalty Engine V2
opportunities.rationale: Developing a sophisticated AI-driven personalization engine can significantly increase customer lifetime value and reduce churn by tailoring product recommendations precisely to individual user behavior.

first_actions: Complete discovery phase for ML data requirements
Allocate budget for specialized data scientist contractor
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in average order value (AOV) by 15% within 12 months.
milestones: Q3: Prototype launched for top 10% of customers
Q4: Full integration and A/B testing rollout

opportunities.title: Hyperlocal Micro-Fulfillment Network
opportunities.rationale: To defend market share against faster delivery competitors, establishing a network of small, automated micro-fulfillment centers in key metropolitan areas could drastically cut last-mile delivery times.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on robotics and warehousing solutions
Identify potential partnership targets with local logistics providers
resources_needed: Capital investment for automated inventory systems
Legal expertise for new operational contracts
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average delivery time by 30% within 18 months.
milestones: Q2: Final site selection and business case approval
Q4: Pilot launch in two target cities

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated task force to evaluate the ROI of adopting the Personalized Loyalty Engine V2.
Initiate a pilot program for hyperlocal micro-fulfillment in one high-density metro area, securing necessary operational agreements.
Conduct an internal skills gap analysis to address the talent needs for advanced data science required by both opportunities.

key_weaknesses: Stagnant core technology stack which limits rapid feature deployment.
High reliance on third-party logistics providers, leading to inconsistent delivery experience.
Talent gap in specialized AI and machine learning expertise needed for next-generation personalization.
